ValidationRule.description: Only the request creator, a System Administrator, a PKR admin or a user with PKR Approve Any can send a decided approval back to Pending.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending"), $User.Id <> Part_Code_Request__r.CreatedById, $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT($Permission.PKR_Deploy_Products), NOT($Permission.PKR_Approve_Any) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the user who created the request or an administrator can send this approval back for approval.
